title: Stand in the recording room at Sun Studio
description: Sun Studio’s modest Memphis room helped launch recordings by Elvis Presley, Johnny Cash, and other early rock and roll artists. On a guided tour, listen to the stories and sounds connected to the equipment and walls around you. It is easy to picture the musicians experimenting together in a space much smaller than its reputation.
teaser: Step inside the Memphis studio where early rock took shape.
goodToKnow: Guided tour; check standing and access requirements.
whyItMightDelightYou: The room makes music history feel close enough to touch, even before the next song plays.
